races.paceDynamic: Thank The Lord will be the sole pace-setter from the gates, giving this moderate field a relatively comfortable tempo through the early stages. With Golden Prosperity, Anglesey Lad, Doralee, Trust Sergei and Tilsworth Ony Ta likely to settle in behind the leader, there's sufficient pace interest to prevent crawling fractions. The large field of 17 runners on Doncaster's turning 5f track will create traffic problems in the closing stages, particularly for those drawn poorly or held up too far back. This race shape strongly favours prominent runners who can secure good early positions without expending excessive energy, as they'll have clear runs when the pace lifts approaching the final furlong.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and Thank The Lord sets sustainable fractions
scenarios.body: The forward-placed horses get first run on the field when the tempo increases, avoiding the inevitable scrimmaging further back in this large field. Those who tracked the pace have tactical advantages and cleaner passages when it matters most.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Thank The Lord goes too fast early or the pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses get perfect conditions to unleash devastating finishes, with the early leaders coming back to them in the final 100 yards. Superior class tells when the race becomes a pure sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wires Field
scenarios.trigger: If Thank The Lord gets soft sectionals and the prominent runners fail to organize a sustained challenge
scenarios.body: The leader kicks clear approaching the final furlong before the hold-up brigade can mount their challenge, sustaining the gallop to the line. Poor draws or traffic problems compromise the closers' finishing efforts.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Thank The Lord stops quickly and no prominent runner takes up the running
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy affair with no clear tempo, leading to a bunched finish where anything can happen. The best horse on the day wins regardless of tactics in a blanket photo finish.

watchPoints.text: Thank The Lord must handle the sustained gallop required to lead this field home, as recent absence could catch up late
Golden Prosperity's draw and early positioning will be crucial given the large field and potential for traffic problems
Opal Storm needs the pace to develop properly to showcase her finishing kick from hold-up position
Several hold-up horses including Masterclass and Canaria Queen face significant tactical challenges in this large field
The claiming jockeys on Masterclass, Doralee and Isla Bella add extra variables to an already complex pace puzzle

races.paceDynamic: Finn Ironside is the sole confirmed front-runner and will dictate terms from the gate, likely getting an uncontested lead with the prominent runners Giant, Mecca's Symphony, Singoura and Pearly Squirrel settling just behind. The large field of 16 hold-up horses including Yafaarr, Pianoforte, Ey Up He's A Star and Wrydcroft will create a cavalry charge from the back half. With no pace pressure on Finn Ironside, this sets up perfectly for closers who can time their run in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce a sustained finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Closers' Paradise
scenarios.trigger: If Finn Ironside sets moderate fractions without pressure and the hold-up brigade gets clear running
scenarios.body: The uncontested leader tires in the final furlong as waves of closers sweep past with Yafaarr, Pianoforte and Ey Up He's A Star ideally suited. Fresh legs prevail over horses that raced prominently throughout.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front End Holds
scenarios.trigger: If Finn Ironside or the prominent group maintain their positions despite the closing challenge
scenarios.body: The early pace proves sustainable and those racing handy avoid traffic problems that hamper the back markers. Pearly Squirrel or Giant capitalize on their forward positions to resist the late charge.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Traffic Chaos Benefits Leaders
scenarios.trigger: If the large field creates severe interference in the straight affecting multiple closers
scenarios.body: Crowded conditions prevent many hold-up horses from delivering their finishing kicks, allowing Finn Ironside or prominent runners to maintain their advantage. Forward positioning proves crucial when clear running becomes premium.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Lone Ranger Escapes
scenarios.trigger: If one hold-up horse gets first run and clear daylight while others are still organizing
scenarios.body: A single closer like Reginald Charles or Sir David breaks clear before the main group can respond, building an unassailable lead. Perfect timing and positioning trumps the superior finishing speed of rivals.

watchPoints.text: Finn Ironside must be monitored for early pace - if he goes too fast the race dynamic completely changes
Traffic problems in straight are almost guaranteed with 16 runners, watch for hold-up horses getting clear runs
Wrydcroft carries penalty for recent wins but arrives in peak form with Rob Hornby maintaining the partnership
Several runners return from lengthy absences including Mecca's Symphony and The New Bay Pearl needing fitness
Headgear applied to Finn Ironside, Yafaarr and Born A Rebel suggests connections expect improved performances

races.paceDynamic: Silver State and Saxophonist will clash early as both confirmed front-runners, with Silver State carrying a 7-pound weight penalty but showing better recent form. This dual-leader setup should create an honest gallop from the start, particularly with prominent runners Toastmaster, Welbury, and Tarmonbarry Kid tracking close behind. The sustained pace will stretch the field and expose any fitness concerns, especially for Saxophonist returning from a 185-day layoff. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those with proven finishing kicks, as the early pace battle will set up a strong tempo for closers to exploit.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Finish
scenarios.trigger: If Silver State and Saxophonist engage in a prolonged speed duel through the early stages
scenarios.body: The dual front-runners will weaken each other, creating gaps for late-running types with proven finishing ability. Booziebrunch's hold-up style becomes a major asset as the pace setters falter in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Silver State establishes an uncontested lead with Saxophonist failing to fire fresh
scenarios.body: Silver State's class advantage shows despite the weight penalty, controlling fractions and kicking clear. The lack of early pressure allows the leader to dictate terms and maintain enough energy for the finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes genuinely strong with multiple horses committed forward
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop plays into the hands of those sitting just off the pace with tactical speed. Toastmaster or Welbury can position perfectly to strike when the leaders weaken approaching the final quarter-mile.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes stop-start with tactical maneuvering from multiple front-runners
scenarios.body: An inconsistent tempo favours horses with turn-of-foot who can adapt to race flow changes. Attention Seeker's light weight becomes crucial in a sprint finish from a bunched field.

watchPoints.text: Silver State and Saxophonist's early battle could compromise both if they engage too aggressively from the start.
Saxophonist's 185-day absence makes him a major fitness risk despite his natural front-running ability.
Booziebrunch needs the pace to develop strongly to utilize his hold-up running style effectively.
Welbury's sharp recent win needs confirming at this higher grade against stronger opposition.
Attention Seeker's light weight advantage could prove decisive if the pace sets up a sprint finish.

races.paceDynamic: Percy's Daydream will lead unchallenged from the gates with all eight rivals adopting hold-up tactics, creating an exceptionally uncontested early gallop over 1m2f. The lone front-runner can dictate terms entirely, setting conservative fractions through the first mile before quickening when ready. With no pace pressure whatsoever, this becomes a tactical crawl that transforms into a sprint finish, heavily favouring horses with tactical speed who can produce sharp bursts rather than sustained gallopers. This race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent tactics over pure hold-up horses who need strong early pace.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Percy's Daydream maintains control and kicks clear approaching the final furlong
scenarios.body: The 218-day break becomes irrelevant as she faces zero early pressure and can time her effort perfectly under Tudhope's patient handling. Her proven 1m2f record (2W6P from similar going) combines with tactical advantage to prove decisive.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Catches Leader
scenarios.trigger: If Percy's Daydream's long absence tells in the final 100 yards and hold-up horses time their runs perfectly
scenarios.body: Ablon and Saliko emerge from the pack with stronger finishing kicks as the leader's 218-day layoff shows late. The Hannon-trained Ablon's recent form edge (1-2 last two) and Saliko's course versatility prove crucial.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Speed Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If the pace becomes genuinely slow and turns into a pure sprint from the 3f pole
scenarios.body: Horses with tactical pace like Little Miss India and Myrrh can position closer to Percy's Daydream and outkick her with fresher legs. The 3-year-old weight advantages for Myrrh and Oh Yes You Do become significant factors.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If the favorite field fails to handle the tactical nature and an unconsidered runner strikes
scenarios.body: Finally Escaped or Alkumatic Jo Jo benefit from the collapsing pace scenario with George Wood and De Sousa timing perfectly from the back. Their recent runs suggest readiness to exploit any tactical errors from more fancied rivals.

watchPoints.text: Percy's Daydream's jump from the gates - if she breaks slowly the entire pace scenario collapses and creates chaos
How close the field allows Percy's Daydream to travel through the first half-mile - any pressure changes everything
Ablon's positioning at halfway - Hannon runners often need prominent positions in weak pace scenarios
The gap Percy's Daydream establishes turning for home - if more than 3 lengths she may be uncatchable
Little Miss India's headgear effect - the hood addition suggests connections expect sharper early pace

races.paceDynamic: Berkshire Schmokin will take this field along as the only confirmed front-runner, likely joined by prominent racers Tommo's Ginjaninja, Rumbustious, and Frustration in the early positions. With no genuine pace pressure, Berkshire Schmokin can dictate terms and set sustainable fractions through the first mile before the field bunches for home. The large contingent of hold-up horses including Kiss For An Angel, Cotton Bud, Brave Leader, and Madjid will need to rely on the pace quickening late to provide the kick they require. This controlled pace scenario strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can avoid traffic and kick from favourable positions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Front Runner Wins
scenarios.trigger: If Berkshire Schmokin gets uncontested fractions and stays strong
scenarios.body: The pace-setter can measure out his effort perfectly and hold off late challenges in a race run to suit his style. McDonald's mount gets first run on the field and has enough left to resist the closers.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent runners can stay close and outkick the leader
scenarios.body: Tommo's Ginjaninja or Rumbustious track the steady pace and have more left in the tank when it matters most. They get the perfect trip behind the pace-setter before unleashing their finishing kick.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The closer contingent gets the slow pace they need to be effective, with Kiss For An Angel or Cotton Bud timing their runs to perfection. The front-runners tie up when asked to quicken after such sedate fractions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Duel Backfires
scenarios.trigger: If Frustration or others press Berkshire Schmokin early
scenarios.body: Any pressure on the leader creates a stronger pace that sets things up for the patient hold-up horses to strike late. The early pace becomes unsustainable and the race falls apart for the leaders in the final furlong.

watchPoints.text: Watch if any of the prominent runners press Berkshire Schmokin early as this could set up a different race entirely for the hold-up horses
Monitor Cotton Bud and Kiss For An Angel despite their long breaks as both have shown ability on good going previously
Keep eye on Risk Averse Rebel who gets significant weight relief and could outrun odds from rear if getting the right pace to aim at
Watch Tommo's Ginjaninja for market support as the Easterby yard is in good form and this filly has been consistent recently
Observe if Berkshire Schmokin gets into any early speed battle as he needs to control the tempo to be effective over this trip
